title: Glenn Gaffney said to have run the crash retrieval program

tellings.quote: be the frontier of defense. There's also a guy who was rumored to to run the whole legacy crash retrieval program named Glenn Gaffne, and he was the CIA's director of science and technology.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says there was a man rumoured to run the whole legacy crash retrieval program, a secret effort said to recover and study crashed craft not made by humans. He names him as Glenn Gaffney, who was the director of science and technology at the CIA, the American foreign spy agency. If true, it would mean one senior intelligence official oversaw the whole hidden effort.
